title: Repeat trial unlocks the app after any follow-up event on the second membership
persona: Trial user, day 7 (QA-PAYWALL, signed webhooks + forged sl_session cookie)
steps: uid qa_tri_12: membership.activated mem_12a status trialing, then membership.deactivated mem_12a status expired
membership.activated mem_12b status trialing -> status trial_used, /slate 307 (correct)
Send membership.updated (or any later event) for mem_12b with status trialing and a renewal_period_end
expected: Second trial stays locked (trial_used) until the user pays.
actual: Second event returns {"ok":true,"status":"trialing"}; all four endpoints return 200. isRepeatTrial compares prev.membership_id with the new one, but the first (blocked) event already stored mem_12b as membership_id, so the next event looks like the same membership and is accepted. A free trial can be repeated indefinitely (Whop normally sends several events per trial, e.g. went_valid + created).
suspected_area: app/src/app/api/webhooks/whop/route.ts + membership.ts isRepeatTrial; the repeat decision is not persisted per membership id, and membership_id is overwritten on the trial_used row
